text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: So who're you watching in today's race?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Do you even have to ask? Considering
the current
lineup, it's obviously Eishin
Flash!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, true. She's the only logical choice,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Keisei Hai, and the
amount of
attention Eishin Flash is
getting is rather high
compared to the
competition.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The audience seems to be favoring me
not for my
skill, but by default.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That is true, and for that, I want to meet
their
expectations.
choice_data_list_en: Still, expectations are what they are.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
In fact... I should naturally be able to do
so just
being myself.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
This race is a no more than a checkpoint
along my
path. I cannot afford to
stumble here.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, that's right. I will do what must be
done.
choice_data_list: いつも通りの君で走れば大丈夫
いつも通りの貴方で走れば大丈夫
choice_data_list_en: Just run like you always do and you'll be fine.
Just run like you normally do and you'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
After this will be the first Classic Triple
Crown
race—the Satsuki Sho.
